name: Sri Lankan Parippu
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) red lentils, rinsed
1 small onion and 2 garlic cloves, sliced
1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds and ½ tsp cumin seeds
steps: Boil the lentils with the turmeric, tomato and water for 15 minutes until soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the mustard and cumin, then cook the onion, garlic, chilli and curry leaves for 5 minutes.
Add the tempering to the lentils with salt.
Stir in the coconut milk and simmer for 3 minutes.
note: A Sri Lankan staple; the small amount of coconut milk gives richness without much saturated fat.
